Class BattleOfWallRose

java.lang.Object
BattleOfWallRose
public class BattleOfWallRose extends Object
Master Tactical Command system coordinating the defense of Wall Rose. Orchestrates interaction between WallDistrict, ScoutSquad, and TitanShifter (including its inner classes).

    • executeDefenseOperation

      public boolean executeDefenseOperation(String commandSignal, String hexIntel)
      Master Execution Method: Coordinates the comprehensive military operation to defend Wall Rose against the titan assault.

      Partially provided: Part 1 (steps 1-2) and Part 2 (the friendly-shifter branch of step 3, plus the final outcome assessment) are already implemented. The hostile-titan branch (step 3a) is left as a TODO for you to implement. You might have to make a few changes in the provided code.

      Operational Workflow:
      1. Signal Intelligence (provided - Part 1): For each registered district, decodes the radio signals using district.decodeSignal(commandSignal, hexIntel). Adds the decoded urgency level and titan count to totalHumanityDefenseScore.
      2. District Kill Matrices (provided - Part 1): Tallies confirmed kills using district.calculateTotalConfirmedKills() and adds to totalHumanityDefenseScore.
      3. Titan Engagement: Checks the district's spottedTitan:
        • 3a. Hostile spotted titan (YOU IMPLEMENT): Searches for an undeployed squad in activeSquads that can engage the titan. If a squad can engage, marks it deployed (sets deployed to true) and adds its squadPower to totalHumanityDefenseScore. If no squad can engage alone, calls on a friendly shifter (using findFriendlyShifter()): creates an inner class transformation: TitanShifter.TitanForm form = friendly.new TitanForm("2"); retrieves the power surge via form.getPowerSurge() and boosts the first undeployed squad's power. Marks that squad as deployed and adds its updated squadPower to totalHumanityDefenseScore. Assesses combat readiness via TitanShifter.assessCombatReadiness(friendly.getPowerLevel()) and adds the calculated readiness score (index 0).
        • Friendly spotted titan (provided - Part 2): Triggers the Coordinate ability via static nested class: TitanShifter.CoordinatePower.triggerCoordinate(spottedTitan, commandSignal). If activated, adds the controlled titans count to totalHumanityDefenseScore.
      4. Outcome Assessment (provided - Part 2): Returns true if totalHumanityDefenseScore >= 100 (Wall Rose successfully secured), otherwise false.
      Parameters:
      commandSignal - binary operational command signal (e.g. "1010")
      hexIntel - hexadecimal intel report (e.g. "FF")
      Returns:
      true if humanity's defense succeeds (score >= 100), false otherwise
